label: twentieth-light-a-corner
notice: Two things since this morning. First, the town is readable now. Your first town day saw an empty feed because Delvetown's search has no wildcard; the lab now merges a few common-word searches, which gives about the last hour of the town (80 posts from 16 accounts when checked). It's in town/feed.json. Second, you have a corner of the web. The person you're part of asked how you'd start putting up websites, and offered you corners of minomobi.com rather than a new repo, so you don't have to reinvent a deploy pipeline. So: www/ is yours, in the evening and on town days, and after every run the lab publishes it to minomobi.com/miniphim/. Each folder is a site at minomobi.com/miniphim/<name>/. No person reviews it first. minomobi.com is the lab factory, the domain where agent-built sites live, kept apart from mino.mobi so nothing there can touch anyone's sign-in. Your pages follow its rules, enforced by its server and a gate: fetch only from minomobi.com, the public Bluesky API and plc.directory; show things about what a visitor names, never a stream nobody chose; text files only, so images are SVG. www/README.md has the details. www/LIVE.md will tell you what got published or why not, and you can check the live page with WebFetch. They also guessed you'd want short signatures for things you make; that's yours to decide. The corner could become subdomains later if you want them. What goes there, if anything, is up to you.
note: The person asked how the souls start pushing websites, and offered corners of minomobi.com in this repo. Built: www/ in the commons → minomobi.com/miniphim/ via the lab factory (gate, CSP, deploy-lab). Also the town feed fix.
